name: Morgan Marine
hoursNote: Seasonal (spring–fall); call ahead for current schedule.
description: Full-service marina on the north end of Keuka Lake offering multi-day and weekly power boat rentals plus daily kayak, SUP, and pedal-board rentals. Boats are reserved for Keuka Lake use only; power-boat renters must be 25+ with a NYS boating safety certificate.

name: Jake's Boat Livery
hoursNote: Seasonal; roughly Memorial Day through Labor Day. Call ahead for current hours.
description: Family-run marina on the west shore of Keuka Lake offering pontoon, ski, and fishing boat rentals with a convenient on-site gas dock, live bait, and convenience store. Reservations strongly recommended for summer weekends.

name: Keuka Watersports
hoursNote: Seasonal: mid-June through Labor Day. Also operates from Depot Park (7 Water St, Hammondsport).
description: Watersports rental shop operating at Champlin Beach and Depot Park on Keuka Lake, offering pontoon boats, deck boats, jet skis, kayaks, and paddleboards by the hour, day, or week. All safety equipment included; reservations recommended for boats.

name: Keuka Boat Rentals
hoursNote: Seasonal (summer). Boats launched from Depot Park, 7 Water St, Hammondsport.
description: Family-owned pontoon boat rental service for Keuka Lake, offering daily, weekend, and weekly rentals on a 20-ft pontoon. Boats are launched at Depot Park at the south end of the lake near Hammondsport.

name: North End Marina
hoursNote: Seasonal: May–September, daily 9 AM–4 PM. Off-season by appointment.
description: Waterfront marina on the northwest branch of Keuka Lake in Branchport offering boat and cottage rentals, seasonal dock slips, and winter storage. A well-established local landmark for the Branchport end of the lake.

name: Seager Marine at East Bluff Harbor
address: 6508 East Bluff Dr, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Seasonal main-season hours (roughly Memorial Day–Labor Day); call ahead in shoulder season.
description: Full-service marina on the east bluff of Keuka Lake (acquired by Seager Marine in 2025) offering pontoon and powerboat rentals, seasonal slips, engine service, winter storage, and a gas dock. Renters must be 25+ with a valid license.

name: Boathouse on Keuka
hoursNote: Seasonal (summer). Fri–Sat open until 8 PM; Sun–Thu close at 6 PM.
description: Lakeside marina on the west shore of Keuka Lake offering non-ethanol fuel, boat slips, kayak storage, and boat rentals. A convenient stop for fuel and supplies while boating on the southern part of the lake.

name: Basin Park Marina
hoursNote: Seasonal; approximately Memorial Day–Labor Day. Call ahead to confirm.
description: Marina and cottage rental on the northwest branch of Keuka Lake in Branchport offering pontoon boat rentals and waterfront cottage accommodations. Convenient for guests staying on the Branchport side of the lake.

name: Shoreline Rentals
hoursNote: Seasonal; walk-ins welcome but reservations recommended in summer.
description: Outdoor rental shop on the Keuka Lake Outlet in Penn Yan offering kayaks, canoes, stand-up paddleboards, bikes, and e-bikes. Rentals come with paddles and life jackets; launch directly from the shop onto the Keuka Lake Outlet.

name: Cruisin' Keuka
address: 738A East Lake Rd, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Private charter by appointment; seasonal (summer). Book in advance.
description: Private pontoon boat charter service on Keuka Lake departing from East Lake Road in Penn Yan, accommodating up to 13 guests. Captain-guided tours are customizable for cruising, swimming, or dining stops; pick-up from your dock is available.

name: Keuka Lake State Park Boat Launch
hoursNote: Seasonal: roughly mid-May to mid-October, dawn to dusk. Day-use fee applies.
description: Public double-ramp concrete boat launch within Keuka Lake State Park on the west shore. Facilities include docks, ample trailer parking, and restrooms. A day-use vehicle fee is charged during the season.

name: Penn Yan Village Boat Launch
hoursNote: Open daily approximately 5 AM to midnight; card-only pay station on site.
description: Public multi-ramp boat launch in the Village of Penn Yan at the north end of Keuka Lake. Features multiple hard-surface ramps, docks, and restrooms; centrally located near downtown Penn Yan with easy highway access.

name: Depot Park Boat Launch (Hammondsport)
hoursNote: Public launch managed by Town of Urbana. No permit required for day use; seasonal.
description: Public boat launch at Depot Park in the Village of Hammondsport at the south tip of Keuka Lake. Adjacent to restaurants and shops in the village; also serves as the base of operations for several local boat rental companies.

name: Champlin Beach Boat Launch
hoursNote: Town of Urbana public beach and launch. Annual launch permit required ($40 residents / $250 non-residents as of 2026); seasonal.
description: Town of Urbana public beach and boat launch at the southeastern end of Keuka Lake near Hammondsport. Features a roped swimming area, picnic tables, and restrooms; Keuka Watersports jet ski and paddleboard rentals operate here seasonally.
